Markets & Applications

Industries We Serve

Engineering forging and machining excellence for high-stress applications in global industrial sectors.

Sector Focus

Diverse Engineering Applications

Bearing Industry

Seamless rolled rings, outer races, and inner races in chrome bearing steel (SAE 52100) for bearing manufacturers.

View Solutions

Automotive Industry

High-precision gear blanks, clutch hubs, transmission joints, and axle pins for passenger cars, trucks, and tractors.

View Solutions

Hydraulic Industry

Case-hardened bushes, cylinder fittings, sleeves, piston rods, and high-pressure glands engineered for leak-free performance.

View Solutions

Oil & Gas Industry

Flanges, high-pressure mechanical seal rings, carbon steel couplings, and custom valve forgings conforming to ASME/API.

View Solutions

Agriculture Industry

Custom tractor hub gears, pins, hitch brackets, and soil preparation equipment components forged to resist abrasive wear.

View Solutions

Power Transmission

Sprocket gears, torque converters, shafts, coupling flanges, and gear reduction blanks forged with aligned structural grain flow.

View Solutions
